categories.main_business_segments: Dezhou United Petroleum Technology Corp. primarily engages in the research, development, production, sales, and leasing of specialized oil and gas drilling tools and equipment. Its business covers directional drilling, horizontal drilling, and surface technical services, serving the oil, natural gas, shale gas, coalbed methane, geothermal drilling, and directional crossing engineering sectors. The company also provides integrated engineering technology services related to drilling operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced technologies in downhole power drilling tools, especially screw drill bits, and wellhead equipment. It employs customized design and manufacturing processes to adapt to harsh environments such as high temperature, high pressure, and high sulfur content. Key technologies include high torque transmission, horizontal well stabilization, expansion screw drill bits, radial bearing manufacturing, rotary impact screw drill bits, motor linear design, and high-temperature rubber formulations. Production follows an order-driven and inventory combined model with strict quality control and continuous innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are large domestic state-owned oil companies including China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC), China Petrochemical Corporation (Sinopec), China National Offshore Oil Corporation (CNOOC), and Shaanxi Yanchang Petroleum Group, along with their subsidiaries and engineering service companies. The company also serves private oilfield engineering service firms and international clients in North America, the Middle East, Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and Russia. Its products and services cater to upstream oil and gas exploration and production sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant domestic market share, especially in major oilfields across regions such as Xinjiang, Sichuan, Gansu, Inner Mongolia, and offshore areas. It has expanded its international presence through subsidiaries and acquisitions in Russia, the United States, and other key oil and gas producing regions. The international markets contribute approximately 19% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dezhou United Petroleum Technology Corp. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the oil and gas supply chain, focusing on manufacturing specialized drilling tools and equipment and providing engineering technical services. It supplies critical equipment and services directly to oilfield operators and service companies, positioning itself as a key equipment provider and service partner in the oil and gas drilling industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in high-performance drilling tools and wellhead equipment to meet evolving demands such as high temperature, high pressure, and complex media conditions. R&D efforts focus on developing integrated downhole measurement tools, high-pressure flexible hoses, ultra-high-pressure fracturing casing heads, and advanced drilling motors. It aims to accelerate product development cycles, enhance product performance, and expand into new markets including international regions and non-oil sectors. Collaboration with research institutes and continuous patent development underpin its innovation strategy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through direct sales of drilling tools and equipment, leasing and maintenance services, and engineering technical service contracts. The company employs a direct sales model supported by domestic and international marketing teams. Leasing revenues are recognized based on actual usage hours as per rental agreements. Engineering services revenue is recognized based on confirmed project work volumes. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dezhou United Petroleum Technology Corp. is one of the leading domestic manufacturers of screw drill bits and wellhead equipment, ranking among the top in market share and production capacity in China. It holds a strong position due to its scale, technical expertise, and stable relationships with major state-owned oil companies. The company faces competition from numerous domestic and international suppliers but maintains competitive advantages through continuous innovation, quality certifications, and integrated product-service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 667 million, a 17.68% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 99 million, up 14.37%. Total assets reached RMB 1.78 billion, growing 9.5% from the previous year. The company’s cash flow from operating activities nearly doubled, reflecting strong operational performance. It has steadily increased R&D investment, accounting for over 3% of revenue, supporting sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and customized drilling tools and equipment capable of operating in extreme environments, providing customers with enhanced drilling efficiency, safety, and longevity. Its integrated product and service model offers comprehensive solutions including equipment leasing, maintenance, and engineering services. Strong R&D capabilities and extensive patent portfolio enable continuous innovation, meeting complex and evolving customer needs. The company’s certifications and stable relationships with major oil companies further differentiate it as a trusted partner in the oil and gas drilling sector.
